subject: MAP follow-up: Integration assembly action plan & owners
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@mediline.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@mediline.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: MAP milestone — integration assembly and owners

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Per our call I wanted to capture the MAP milestone we discussed for the integration build so we can lock owners and target dates: 

High-level ask: get a working SDK integration with streaming + tool-calling and a structured output schema in the sandbox environment. Key dependencies are network whitelisting, security questionnaire responses, and a sample data payload for schema verification.

Draft milestones (from Mediline):
- Milestone A: SDK integration (connect to Mediline sandbox, auth, basic inference flows) — target: mid-November
- Milestone B: Streaming & low-latency KV cache validation — target: mid-November
- Milestone C: Tool calling + structured JSON outputs for downstream systems — target: late-November

Attachments: MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft), integration_spec.xlsx (initial schema and sample payloads).

Can you confirm Redwood owners for each milestone and realistic ETA to include in the MAP? Also please flag any blockers on your side so we can prioritize internal work.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Head of Platform Integrations
Mediline Health

---

(attachment stubs: MAP_v1.pdf (12 KB, PDF), integration_spec.xlsx (34 KB, XLSX))

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@mediline.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: MAP milestone — integration assembly and owners

Laura — thanks for the clear recap. See below for a proposed assignment and pragmatic ETA we can commit to in the MAP. I put owners who will be the primary point for each milestone and a short rationale.

Proposed MAP entries (Redwood owner — estimated effort — target completion):
- SDK integration (owner: jordan_blake — SDK lead). Scope: language SDKs, auth flows (API keys + tenant mapping), client examples. Estimate: 5 business days work. Target: 2026-11-10.
- Streaming & KV (owner: dev_patel — infra/serving). Scope: streaming API, continuous batching, KV cache warmup and sizing tests. Estimate: 7 business days (includes perf runs). Target: 2026-11-12.
- Tool calling + structured outputs (owner: marissa_cole — solutions eng). Scope: define tool-calling contract, structured JSON outputs, sample post-processing hooks for Mediline's downstream systems. Estimate: 4 business days. Target: 2026-11-15.

Primary dependencies and blockers we see:
- Network: need firewall/whitelist for Redwood sandbox IPs (customer owns ticketing).
- Security: Mediline to return the completed questionnaire and any SOC2 evidence required for on-prem/staged testing.
- Data: a representative sample payload with expected fields and up-to-3 example records for schema validation.

Next steps: 
1) Jordan will schedule a 60-min dev sync (calendar invite to follow) to align on SDK auth and example flows.
2) Dev and Marcus to do a short perf/throughput plan doc and share by end of week (will upload to the Drive link).
3) Marissa will draft the tool-calling contract and proposed structured output schema and attach to updated MAP.

I've attached an updated playbook workbook (integration_playbook_v2.xlsx) that lists owners, acceptance criteria, and the sprint-level breakdown. If those owners look good, we'll update the MAP_v1.pdf and share the MAP_v2 for signature in the next 48 hours.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Solutions & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

(attachment stub: integration_playbook_v2.xlsx (28 KB, XLSX))

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@mediline.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: MAP milestone — integration assembly and owners

Adding some technical detail to set expectations from the engineering side. Quick summary of the plan and blocker list: 

Technical breakdown and rough effort (engineering calendar days):
- SDK integration: 5 dev days — tasks: auth adapter, example client, integration tests against Mediline sandbox.
- Streaming + KV: 7 dev days — tasks: streaming handler, continuous batching tuning, KV cache warmup tests with 1M token synthetic workload.
- Tool calling + structured outputs: 4 dev days — tasks: tool-call shim, output schema validators, example transformation pipelines.

Total dev effort (not including QA and PS): ~16 dev days. With QA and coordination, plan for 3 sprint weeks to be safe.

Immediate blockers we need from Mediline: 
- Network: sandbox IP whitelist (list of IPs attached in integration_playbook_v2.xlsx).
- Sample payloads: a minimum of 3 representative example records in JSON; include any null/edge fields.
- Expected rate / concurrency numbers so we can size throughput tests.

Small ask: can you send a sanitized sample payload and confirm who on your security team will own the questionnaire responses? If security can return answers by 2026-11-05 we can keep to the dates Marcus suggested.

I'll be on the dev sync and will own the perf runs.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Marcus / team — this looks good and thank you for the quick breakdown. We agree to the proposed owners: Jordan, Dev, Marissa. A few confirmations from our side: 

- Mediline will provide a sanitized sample payload by 2026-11-04.
- Security will complete the questionnaire and share SOC2 pointer by 2026-11-05.
- I will open a firewall ticket today for sandbox whitelisting and add the ticket number to the Drive doc.

We are comfortable with the target completion window (Nov 10–15) and will treat the SDK integration as critical path. Please go ahead and publish MAP_v2 once you incorporate our dates — we'll review and sign off.

Next actions for this thread: Jordan schedule dev sync; Marcus upload updated MAP_v2; Mediline send payload + security contact.

Best,
